items.title: USClaims (US financial services) claimed by Direwolf
items.summary: On November 3 the Direwolf group listed USClaims on its leak site and threatened to publish stolen data unless the company makes contact; the claim is unverified.

items.title: Dark Project gang reaches 38 victims across 8 countries
items.summary: Dark Project has posted 38 victims, mostly in healthcare and manufacturing, including four new listings so far in November after five each in September and October.

items.title: BlackFog: State of Ransomware, October 2026
items.summary: BlackFog's monthly tally of publicly disclosed attacks for October, the latest full-month baseline for comparing November activity.

ransomware.note: Few named November victims are indexed yet, and leak-site claims are unverified. Check ransomware.live for the live feed.

items.title: DreamHost multi-day hosting outage tied to breach
items.summary: DreamHost's multi-day service outage last week was part of an intrusion into its File Manager system that it disclosed on November 5.

items.title: Rogers internet down in BC Cariboo after fibre cut
items.summary: On November 5 a fibre cable cut knocked out Rogers internet in 100 Mile House, Williams Lake and Quesnel; service was back by 3:40 p.m.

items.title: DoorDash app, checkout and earnings failures (user reports)
items.summary: Downdetector showed about 1,100 US reports on November 6 covering app, checkout and missing-earnings problems; DoorDash had not confirmed an outage.

items.title: GitHub 502s and Actions errors reported (unconfirmed)
items.summary: About 570 users reported 502 errors and failed PRs and Actions on November 5, but GitHub's status page showed core services as operational.

items.title: Google Antigravity degraded performance
items.summary: StatusGator logged a possible outage on November 6, with 274 user reports of slow or failed agent runs in 24 hours.

outage.note: No major AWS, Azure or Google Cloud outage so far in November. The latest big one was the Google Cloud europe-west2-b power event on Oct 20 (about 5.5 hours).

items.title: DreamHost breach exposed FTP/SFTP credentials and webmail
items.summary: DreamHost disclosed that attackers who got in through its File Manager in August obtained customer FTP/SFTP logins and some webmail access; it has forced password resets.

items.title: Zyxel GS1900 switch hacks used a zero-day (CVE-2026-107441)
items.summary: Binarly found that a recently patched flaw was exploited as a zero-day before the patch, compromising almost 1,000 Zyxel switches.

items.title: WordPress Core CVE-2026-119977 added to CISA KEV
items.summary: CISA added a WordPress Core flaw in the upgrade staging paths to KEV; it allows unauthenticated code execution during an upgrade.

items.title: Node-RED CVE-2026-58115 exploited in the wild
items.summary: Attackers are using a critical Node-RED flaw to get unauthenticated code execution on exposed servers.

items.title: Chainstack production breach exposed customer data
items.summary: Blockchain infrastructure provider Chainstack reported a breach of its production systems that exposed customer data and password hashes.

items.title: WorkOS internal sales app accessed, CRM data exposed
items.summary: WorkOS said an attacker got into an internal sales application and exposed CRM data; reports linking it to a specific group are unverified.

items.title: Historic flooding across Arizona, Colorado and New Mexico
items.summary: Heavy rain on November 1 caused historic flooding, mandatory evacuations and road closures across the Southwest, including helicopter rooftop rescues in Sedona, AZ.

items.title: SW Colorado assessing damage after two floods; utilities and gas lines hit
items.summary: The San Juan River at Pagosa Springs crested near 17 feet in the second flood; there were utility outages and natural-gas pipeline ruptures, and about 50 people were evacuated.

items.title: Weekly disaster update: storm system moving east
items.summary: The Center for Disaster Philanthropy's November 2 roundup tracks the Southwest floods and the storm system expected to bring rain to the central and eastern US this week.

physical.note: USGS lists no significant earthquakes this week. No November tropical-cyclone or wildfire events found.
